'''South Mist Storage Link Phase V''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is located in Oregon.

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Northwest Natural Gas Co<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''320 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''50 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''24 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$85,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
